name: motion-harness
title_zh: Remotion 剪辑师的一双眼睛和手
tagline_zh: 改片尾按钮点早了？不用整片渲染。它把时间码定位到场景和帧，秒出检查帧与联系表。
tagline_en: Fix 'button clicks too late' without full renders. Locates timecodes to scenes/frames, outputs check frames &.
desc_en: Work on a Remotion film with eyes and hands. Use whenever you edit, review, or verify a Remotion composition that has a harness.config.ts: resolve feedback like "second 21" or "the check button clicks too late" to a scene and frame, render check frames and contact sheets in seconds instead of full renders, read element boxes and painted colors from the DOM, measure motion, mix the film from the ti
why_zh: 它把「看片」变成「查图」：用 harness.config.ts 把模糊反馈映射到具体帧。
why_en: Turns film review into image inspection: maps vague feedback to exact frames via harness.config.ts, bypasses slow renders, shows.
limit_zh: 只认 Remotion 且项目里要有 harness.config.ts；不生成最终视频，只出检查帧和联系表。
limit_en: Remotion only, requires harness.config.ts; outputs check frames/contact sheets, not final video; needs DOM access, won't run headless without browser.
title_en: Eyes and hands for Remotion editing: locate frames.
